_comment: Copy to dealerships.json. `our_dealer` is Volkswagen North Scottsdale.
URLs and platforms below were verified live 2026-08-11. Dealer websites get
replatformed without notice, so if a dealer suddenly extracts 0 units, assume
the site changed before assuming the dealer ran out of cars.

dealerships.name: Volkswagen North Scottsdale
dealerships.verified: 2026-08-11 SRP 403/shell, but per-model pages readable via markdown fetcher (Tiguan=32 units w/ VIN+MSRP; 127 total). MSRP ONLY - no discount published.
notes: THIS IS US. Every figure is relative to this store.
COLLECTION: /new-vehicles/ returns only a nav shell, but per-model pages
render listings and are readable with a markdown-converting fetcher. Use
model_slugs to walk the lineup - it also sidesteps SRP pagination.
CRITICAL FINDING: every listing shows MSRP and nothing else - no dealer
discount, no rebate, no sale price, no 'contact for price'. Competitors
publish discounted prices the same day. Our discount COMPOSITION is not
recoverable from the public site; use the DMS feed for that.
Confirm with management whether MSRP-only is display or policy - the two
call for opposite responses. See analysis-playbook.md section 1b.
cars.com 'MSRP' is BASE msrp; its 'listed price' equals the as-configured
MSRP on our own site (verified on VIN 3VVUW7RM6TM130947 = $47,005). We are
listing AT sticker, not above it - an earlier above-MSRP reading was that

dealerships.name: Lunde's Peoria Volkswagen
dealerships.notes: Sincro/DealerOn-family markers present. Lower VIN yield per page than the DDC stores - page through fully before trusting a model count.

dealerships.name: Berge Volkswagen (Gilbert)
dealerships.verified: 2026-08-11 HTTP 403 to plain requests - BOT BLOCKED
dealerships.notes: Blocks scripted fetches. Use the cloakbrowser skill. Largest VW store in the Phoenix market by its own claim, so omitting it materially distorts any market average - never let this one silently drop out.

dealerships.name: Camelback Volkswagen (Phoenix)
dealerships.verified: 2026-08-11 HTTP 200, 24 units/page, full itemized dprice ladder
dealerships.notes: Advertised price INCLUDES a $599 doc fee. Every unit observed carried dealer-added accessories and conditional offers.

dealerships.name: Chapman Volkswagen Scottsdale
dealerships.notes: Closest geographic rival - the other Scottsdale VW store, so it competes for the same walk-in and search traffic we do. Watch this one hardest. Two live domains on different platforms: chapmanvw.com (Fox) responds and exposes msrp/discountsTotal/markupsTotal/rebatesEveryoneTotal; chapman-vw.com is Dealer.com and blocks scripted fetches. Confirm which is the live retail site so inventory is not double-counted.

thresholds._comment: Overrides for analyze_pricing.py. Anchored to VW front-end gross of roughly $1.5-2.5k/unit.

_syndication: cars.com reaches every blocked store and its MSRP/price match dealer sites exactly, but it publishes NO discount breakdown. Use for coverage, depth and price levels; never for dealer-discount recommendations on its own.
